end

questions.title: FizzBuzz Branch
questions.description: What does the following Ruby snippet print when n = 15?
questions.codesnippet:
n = 15
if n % 3 == 0 && n % 5 == 0
  puts "fizzbuzz"
elsif n % 3 == 0
  puts "fizz"
elsif n % 5 == 0
  puts "buzz"
else
  puts n
end

questions.title: Overdue Short Circuit
questions.description: What does the following Ruby snippet print?
questions.codesnippet:
code = "guest"
overdue = true
if overdue
  puts "denied"
else
  case code
  when "student" then puts "5 books"
  when "faculty" then puts "20 books"
  else puts "2 books"
  end
end
